meta.title: The Frog-Prince
meta.author: The Brothers Grimm
meta.blurb: A princess drops her golden ball into a deep spring, and a frog offers to fetch it back. She promises him anything. She doesn't mean it. The frog does.
meta.mood: A cool spring in the greenwood

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: One fine evening a young princess put on her bonnet and clogs, and went out to take a walk by herself in a wood; and when she came to a cool spring of water, that rose in the midst of it, she sat herself down to rest a while. Now she had a golden ball in her hand, which was her favourite plaything; and she was always tossing it up into the air, and catching it again as it fell. After a time she threw it up so high that she missed catching it as it fell; and the ball bounded away, and rolled along upon the ground, till at last it fell down into the spring. The princess looked into the spring after her ball, but it was very deep, so deep that she could not see the bottom of it. Then she began to bewail her loss, and said

segments.text: Then the frog put his head down, and dived deep under the water; and after a little while he came up again, with the ball in his mouth, and threw it on the edge of the spring.
